```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Load time-weight data
tW <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_poculata_apo/tW_predictions.csv")

# Load temperature-respiration data
TJO <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_poculata_apo/TJO_predictions.csv")

TJO$resp_pred <- Re(TJO$resp_pred)  #MATLAB included some non-real numbers so just turning them into real numbers
```


```{r}
# Plot observed vs. predicted weight over time
ggplot(tW, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = weight_obs), color = "black", size = 2, shape = 16) +  # observed
  geom_line(aes(y = weight_pred), color = "blue", size = 1) +               # predicted
  labs(title = "Time vs. Dry Weight",
       x = "Time (days)",
       y = "Dry Weight (g)") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}


# Plot observed vs. predicted respiration
ggplot(TJO, aes(x = temperature)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = resp_obs), color = "black", size = 2, shape = 16) +   # observed
  geom_line(aes(y = resp_pred), color = "red", size = 1) +                 # predicted
  labs(title = "Temperature vs. O2 Consumption",
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = "O2 Consumption (µmol/g/d)") +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
ggplot(tW, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = weight_obs), color = "black", size = 2, shape = 16) +  # observed
  geom_smooth(aes(y = weight_pred), method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "blue", size = 1) +  # smoothed predicted
  labs(title = "Time vs. Dry Weight",
       x = "Time (days)",
       y = "Dry Weight (g)") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
ggplot(TJO, aes(x = temperature)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = resp_obs), color = "black", size = 2, shape = 16) +  # observed
  geom_smooth(aes(y = resp_pred), method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "blue", size = 1) +  # smoothed predicted
  labs(title = "Temperature vs. O2 Consumption",
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = "O2 Consumption (µmol/g/d)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
